claimLimit: Outer recorder r2 is unrun and does not authorize an exact launch or H mirror mutation

findings.issue: Recorder disarms SIGALRM before process-group TERM/KILL waits (up to 3+3+1 seconds) and receipt write. Thus 210 seconds does not bound bootstrap+child+cleanup+receipt as claimed; synthetic RED accepts elapsed under 10 seconds for a 2-second limit. Version an explicit whole-recorder deadline or separately labeled finite cleanup grace with reviewed outer cap and refusal.

LAUNCH_START silently defaults to module import time if the loader fails to supply it. Static contract must require an authenticated launch start before loader file reads, validate monotonic elapsed in [0,210), and refuse missing/duplicate start; otherwise exact command can inadvertently omit bootstrap time.

safe_result writes through a stable dirfd but never rechecks the parent pathname or reads back the O_EXCL receipt after fsync. A parent replacement can make the apparent success/STOP result unreachable; add path identity and hash/readback guard.

positiveFindings: Embedded bootstrap exact source/static/HEAD pins match r1 authenticated bytes.
